device: Wattsonic MATIC hybrid inverter, SunSpec Modbus interface

conventions.scale_factor: value = raw x 10^sf, sf read from the sunssf point named in 'sf' (device.sf_address).
conventions.not_implemented: int16 0x8000, uint16 0xFFFF, acc32/uint32 0x00000000/0xFFFFFFFF as defined by SunSpec; skip such readings.
conventions.access: 'access' is the SunSpec model declaration; device.writable / device.write_range state what this device accepts. Writes to any other point are answered with exception 0x02.
conventions.requests: A request that starts inside the map must end at or before map_end; a request never covers native and SunSpec registers together.

points.name: StActCtl
points.label: StActCtl
points.desc: Which inverter controls are currently active.

device.description:
Active control functions as selected by the controller: bit 0 FixedW while an active-power limit is selected (native EMS interface or SunSpec); bit 1 FixedVAR or bit 2 FixedPF or bit 9 Watt-PF according to the selected reactive-power mode; bit 4 Freq-Watt-Param, bit 7 LVRT, bit 8 HVRT and bit 10 Volt-Watt while the corresponding grid-code function is configured. Describes the selection made by the controller, not an acknowledgement from the power converter.
